description: Entries in the business's books, newest first, optionally for some dates or matching a word in the description or category (GET /books/entries). Needs real data (live key).

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out to start from the first entry.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1 to 200, default 50).

search.description: Only entries whose description or category contains this.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.
